record.title: Prepare the required SCPI evidence directories before stock execution
record.intent: Correct local output layout without changing physical or numerical semantics.
requirements: Preserve both stopped attempts and independently review the missing-directory failure. No observer, native removal or reboot occurred; do not claim stock from a complete transport connection.

Inspect all transition output preconditions and prepare a distinct run using the unchanged frozen controller and actual lease/configuration. Create the three required empty SCPI evidence directories before execution; reject missing, occupied or symlink output paths in offline preflight.

Test the real query-helper directory gate with a fail-on-use socket control, verify unchanged inputs and all physical gates, independently review readiness, and commit/push the correction before execution.
acceptance: Local evidence layout supports one unchanged gated baseline attempt or an explicit hold.
